title: TechForDad, October 2026
subject: Fall safety, new gift guides, and what's new at TechForDad
preview: Simple tech ideas for the parents and grandparents in your life.
intro: Thank you for being part of TechForDad. Here is what's new this month, and one practical idea for keeping a loved one safe as the days get shorter.

blocks.heading: This month's idea: make the home safer for fall and winter
paragraphs: Falls are one of the most common reasons an older adult ends up in hospital, and darker evenings make them more likely. Good lighting, a way to call for help and a clear path through the house make a real difference.
Our guides walk through the simple, affordable fixes, with no technical knowledge needed.

after.tail: covers room by room what to check.

blocks.heading: New: Gift Guides for the holidays
paragraphs: Not sure what to buy for a parent or grandparent? We have put together six guides, from budget-friendly ideas to gifts for someone living with dementia and safety gadgets for people who live alone.
Prices change often, so each guide says when it was last checked.
